title: PerSPL: Personalized Semi-supervised Preference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29219v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized reward models require user-specific preference comparisons, but collecting such feedback is costly and provides only limited supervision for each user. At the same time, large pools of responses can be generated without user identities or preference labels, yet existing personalized reward models leave this data unused. Directly learning from these responses is difficult because pairwise objectives constrain relative scores within a prompt, whereas pseudo-labeling individual responses requires scores that are comparable across prompts for the same user. We propose \textbf{PerSPL} (Personalized Semi-supervised Preference Learning), a backbone-agnostic framework that uses pair-mean score centering to stabilize this cross-prompt score coordinate and iteratively turns unlabeled responses into user-specific training signals. translated_title: PerSPL：个性化半监督偏好学习
translated_abstract: 个性化奖励模型需要用户特定的偏好比较数据，但收集这类反馈成本高昂，且只能为每个用户提供有限的监督信号。与此同时，大量响应可以在不涉及用户身份或偏好标签的情况下生成，然而现有的个性化奖励模型并未利用这些数据。直接从这些响应中学习是困难的，因为成对目标函数约束的是同一提示内的相对分数，而对单个响应进行伪标注则需要同一用户在不同提示之间可比较的分数。我们提出了 PerSPL（个性化半监督偏好学习），这是一个与骨干模型无关的框架，它利用成对均值分数中心化来稳定这种跨提示的分数坐标系，并迭代地将无标签响应转化为用户特定的训练信号。在四个基准（PersonalLLM、HelpSteer2、Reddit TLDR 以及……）上与七个代表性基线进行了对比（摘要至此被截断）。
tldr: 提出PerSPL框架，通过成对均值分数中心化来稳定跨提示的分数坐标系，从而迭代地将大量无标签响应转化为用户特定的训练信号，以低成本方式提升个性化奖励模型的学习效果。
en_tdlr: PerSPL is a backbone-agnostic framework that stabilizes cross-prompt score comparability via pair-mean score centering, iteratively converting abundant unlabeled responses into user-specific training signals for personalized reward modeling.
